title: Brew-Fridge Compressor Duty Cycle
dataSources: Fermentation telemetry (`brew:fermentation`), brew-day records (`brew:batch`), mash probes (`brew:mash`), keg pressure (`kegerator:pressure`), tap pours (`kegerator:pour`), brew-fridge duty logs (`brewfridge:compressor`), cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`), and line-cleaning events (`tapline:clean`).
app: Homebrewing telemetry from Tilt/iSpindel fermentation sensors, Brewfather batch exports, ESPHome mash and fridge probes, keg pressure sensors, tap flow meters, and cellar climate sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewfridge:compressor
| timechart span=1h avg(duty_cycle_pct) as duty_cycle_pct by fridge
| where duty_cycle_pct>0
description: Shows how hard the fermentation fridge compressor is working over time so you can spot insulation or control issues.
value: Duty cycle reveals hidden stress on cooling gear long before a batch gets warm, making it a practical reliability indicator for fermentation control.
implementation: Log compressor on/off state or derived duty cycle from a smart plug controlling the brew fridge.
visualization: Time chart of compressor duty cycle by fridge.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how hard the brewing fridge is working, which can warn you about trouble before it stops keeping beer cool.
